program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    fill = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v == fill for v in row) < len(row) / 2]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if sum(grid[i][j] == fill for i in range(h)) < h / 2]
    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    node_vals = [grid[r][c] for r in rows for c in cols]
    border = Counter(node_vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[fill for _ in range(len(cols)-1)] for _ in range(len(rows)-1)]
    for i in range(len(rows)-1):
        for j in range(len(cols)-1):
            corners = [grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j+1]],
                       grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j+1]]]
            if corners[0] != border and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners):
                out[i][j] = corners[0]
    while len(out) > 1 and all(v == fill for v in out[0]):
        out.pop(0)
    while len(out) > 1 and all(v == fill for v in out[-1]):
        out.pop()
    return out
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    fill = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v == fill for v in row) < len(row) / 2]

    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    node_vals = [grid[r][c] for r in rows for c in cols]
    border = Counter(node_vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[fill for _ in range(len(cols)-1)] for _ in range(len(rows)-1)]
    for i in range(len(rows)-1):
        for j in range(len(cols)-1):
            corners = [grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j+1]],
                       grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j+1]]]
            if corners[0] != border and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners):
                out[i][j] = corners[0]
    while len(out) > 1 and all(v == fill for v in out[0]):
